speaker: john_shakespeare
text: Set another billet on the dogs, Edmund. The April wind comes under that door like a clerk.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Before the fire goes down. One thing apiece from London, and no changing it on the stair tomorrow. Susanna first.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: A book in English, with no riddles in it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou hast had the riddle-book, and read it out already?

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: I read the answers on the second day, and half of them cheat. I want a book where the people say what they mean.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: I want a song nobody in Stratford has. Not a psalm.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: If I send it on paper, who will read the words to thee?

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: Susanna will read it once, because she likes to show she can. After once I have it.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: It is my turn. Was the sword ever in a real fight?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It has killed the same man four times a year since before you were born.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: Then he was a player, and that is a fight I understand. I am satisfied.

speaker: edmund_shakespeare
text: Say it again, the bit about the horse. No, as Master Burbage would say it. And why may I not ride behind thee and begin? Nick Sorrell's scarce older than I.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nick is not thy road. Thou art fourteen till the third of May, and fifteen is for school.

speaker: edmund_shakespeare
text: I did not say I would be a chief player. I said I would begin.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Begin with thy Latin, and a hand a man can read by one candle. When that is true, we will talk of what begins.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: He has heard thee, Edmund. Take thy heels off the hearth-stone.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: Fifteen. At fifteen I had a voice could carry from the Cross to the bridge. How went the catch, Will? The one with the cat.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have not got it, sir. You have the start of it, if anyone does.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: Jack boy, ho boy, news, the cat is in the well.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: There was a parish clerk in the second part. He has gone. God's my comfort, I had him at Christmas.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: You stopped. That is the half. Nobody in this room has the rest.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: Then the rest is safe from us. My throat is dry with the smoke.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: Mother says the hour is gone, and Hamnet has the lath across the board.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Up, all three. Put the blade by the chest, Hamnet. Do not try a fight on the stair.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: Only to see if the point is still a point.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Up. Your father rides before you wake.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One thing each, and heard. That is the slate. I am not adding to it from the stair.
